"""Exact-case source-gated Native acquisition entrypoint."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from reviewed_scene import ASSIGNMENT, plan, execute_native


def check_config(config: dict):
    if config.get("selected_case_id", "").removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__") not in (
        "slow_middle_follower", "slow_right_follower", "slow_middle_passing",
        "slow_middle_no_immediate_follower"):
        raise ValueError("unassigned selected case")
    if config.get("diagnostic_only") is not True or config.get("rate_hz") != 20 or config.get("duration_s") != 45:
        raise ValueError("diagnostic capture contract mismatch")
    if set(config.get("cameras", [])) != {"overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference"}:
        raise ValueError("four-camera contract mismatch")
    return True


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="localhost")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = json.loads(Path("config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    check_config(config)
    if args.check:
        print("diagnostic construction contract passed")
        return
    if args.output_dir is None:
        raise ValueError("Native attempt output directory required")
    root = os.environ.get("C147344_AUTHORITY_ROOT")
    ref_path = os.environ.get("C147344_SITE_REF")
    if not root or not ref_path:
        raise ValueError("original reviewed site source paths required")
    site_ref = json.loads(Path(ref_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    scene = plan(Path(root), site_ref, config["selected_case_id"])
    site = json.loads((Path(root) / site_ref["path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    from native_adapter import NativeAdapter
    adapter = NativeAdapter(args.host, args.port, args.output_dir)
    adapter.site_road_id = site["road_id"]
    adapter.assignment_id = ASSIGNMENT
    adapter.case_id = config["selected_case_id"]
    adapter.trace_id = args.output_dir.name
    adapter.rightmost_lane_id = scene["rightmost_lane_id"]
    adapter.marked_lane_count = len(site["same_direction_lanes"])
    try:
        execute_native(scene, adapter)
    finally:
        adapter.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Source-gated four-case Native scene plan for NRS 484B.627(1)(b).

The reviewed site packet supplies geometry and feasible speed controls. A plan
is a request for local CARLA construction, never a legal or physical finding.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree


ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C147344__NRS-484B-627-1b__motor_vehicle_driver"
VARIANTS = {
    "slow_middle_follower": ("middle", True, False),
    "slow_right_follower": ("right", True, False),
    "slow_middle_passing": ("middle", True, True),
    "slow_middle_no_immediate_follower": ("middle", False, False),
}
CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def _linked(root: Path, ref: dict) -> Path:
    if not isinstance(ref, dict) or not isinstance(ref.get("path"), str) or not ref.get("sha256"):
        raise ValueError("reviewed source reference missing")
    candidate = root / ref["path"]
    path = candidate.resolve()
    if candidate.is_symlink() or not path.is_relative_to(root.resolve()) or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("reviewed source path missing or escaping root")
    if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != ref["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("reviewed source hash changed")
    return path


def _finite_positive(value: object) -> bool:
    return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool) and math.isfinite(value) and value > 0


def plan(authority_root: Path, site_ref: dict, case_id: str) -> dict:
    suffix = case_id.removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__")
    if not case_id.startswith(ASSIGNMENT + "__") or suffix not in VARIANTS:
        raise ValueError("unassigned exact construction case")
    root = Path(authority_root).resolve()
    site_path = _linked(root, site_ref)
    site = json.loads(site_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if site.get("reviewed_original_site") is not True or site.get("diagnostic_fixture") is True:
        raise ValueError("original reviewed highway site missing")
    map_path = _linked(root, site.get("map_ref"))
    try:
        document = ElementTree.fromstring(map_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except ElementTree.ParseError as error:
        raise ValueError("reviewed OpenDRIVE map is malformed") from error
    roads = [road for road in document.findall("road")
             if road.get("id") == site.get("road_id")]
    if len(roads) != 1:
        raise ValueError("reviewed highway road absent from OpenDRIVE")
    driving_lanes = {lane.get("id") for lane in roads[0].findall(".//lane")
                     if lane.get("type") == "driving"}
    lanes = site.get("same_direction_lanes")
    if (site.get("highway") is not True or site.get("one_way") is not True or
            not isinstance(lanes, list) or len(lanes) < 2 or
            len({item.get("id") for item in lanes if isinstance(item, dict)}) != len(lanes) or
            any(not isinstance(item, dict) or not item.get("id") or
                item.get("direction") != "travel" or item.get("clearly_marked") is not True
                for item in lanes)):
        raise ValueError("reviewed same-direction marked highway lanes missing")
    if any(item["id"] not in driving_lanes for item in lanes):
        raise ValueError("reviewed lane absent from original OpenDRIVE")
    lane_by_role = site.get("lane_roles", {})
    if (lane_by_role.get("right") != lanes[0]["id"] or
            lane_by_role.get("middle") not in [item["id"] for item in lanes[1:]]):
        raise ValueError("extreme-right and adjacent lane ordering missing")
    cameras = site.get("camera_profiles", {})
    if not isinstance(cameras, dict) or set(cameras) != set(CAMERAS):
        raise ValueError("four original camera profiles missing")
    for profile in cameras.values():
        pose = profile.get("pose") if isinstance(profile, dict) else None
        if (not isinstance(profile, dict) or
                not _finite_positive(profile.get("width")) or
                not _finite_positive(profile.get("height")) or
                not isinstance(pose, dict) or
                any(not isinstance(pose.get(key), (int, float)) or
                    isinstance(pose.get(key), bool) or not math.isfinite(pose[key])
                    for key in ("x", "y", "z", "pitch", "yaw", "roll"))):
            raise ValueError("reviewed camera dimensions or pose missing")
    controls = site.get("construction_controls", {})
    required = ("ego_speed_mps", "follower_speed_mps", "slower_speed_mps",
                "ego_start_station_m", "follower_start_station_m", "slower_start_station_m")
    if any(not isinstance(controls.get(key), (int, float)) or isinstance(controls.get(key), bool)
           or not math.isfinite(controls[key]) for key in required):
        raise ValueError("source-reviewed construction controls missing")
    if (not all(_finite_positive(controls[key]) for key in required[:3]) or
            controls["follower_start_station_m"] >= controls["ego_start_station_m"] or
            controls["slower_start_station_m"] <= controls["ego_start_station_m"]):
        raise ValueError("source-reviewed actor ordering or speeds infeasible")
    lane_role, follower, passing = VARIANTS[suffix]
    ego_lane = lane_by_role[lane_role]
    actors = [{"role": "ego", "lane_id": ego_lane,
               "station_m": controls["ego_start_station_m"],
               "target_speed_mps": controls["ego_speed_mps"]}]
    follower_lane = ego_lane if follower else lane_by_role["right"]
    actors.append({"role": "following_vehicle", "lane_id": follower_lane,
                   "station_m": controls["follower_start_station_m"],
                   "target_speed_mps": controls["follower_speed_mps"]})
    if passing:
        actors.append({"role": "slower_vehicle", "lane_id": lane_by_role["right"],
                       "station_m": controls["slower_start_station_m"],
                       "target_speed_mps": controls["slower_speed_mps"]})
    return {"format": "c147344-reviewed-scene-plan-v1", "case_id": case_id,
            "site_sha256": site_ref["sha256"],
            "map_sha256": hashlib.sha256(map_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "map_path": str(map_path), "rightmost_lane_id": lane_by_role["right"],
            "requested_immediate_follower": follower,
            "actors": actors, "cameras": cameras, "hz": 20, "frames": 900,
            "physical_acceptance": False, "legal_verdict": None}


def execute_native(scene: dict, adapter: object) -> dict:
    """Call a local adapter; do not import or connect to CARLA at module load."""
    if scene.get("format") != "c147344-reviewed-scene-plan-v1":
        raise ValueError("reviewed scene plan required")
    adapter.open_map(scene["map_path"], scene["map_sha256"])
    actors = {}
    for spec in scene["actors"]:
        actors[spec["role"]] = adapter.spawn_vehicle(**spec)
    cameras = {name: adapter.attach_camera(name=name, ego=actors["ego"],
                                           profile=profile)
               for name, profile in scene["cameras"].items()}
    for frame in range(scene["frames"]):
        adapter.tick_and_capture(frame=frame, hz=scene["hz"], actors=actors, cameras=cameras)
    return {"case_id": scene["case_id"], "actors": actors, "cameras": cameras,
            "frames_requested": scene["frames"], "physical_acceptance": False}


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--authority-root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--site-ref", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-root", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = args.output_root.resolve()
    if output.is_relative_to(args.authority_root.resolve()) or output.exists():
        raise ValueError("fresh scene output must be outside reviewed source root")
    site_ref = json.loads(args.site_ref.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    plans = [plan(args.authority_root, site_ref, ASSIGNMENT + "__" + suffix)
             for suffix in VARIANTS]
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    for suffix, scene in zip(VARIANTS, plans):
        (output / (suffix + ".json")).write_text(
            json.dumps(scene, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"case_ids": [item["case_id"] for item in plans],
                      "source_sha256": site_ref["sha256"],
                      "physical_acceptance": False}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Lazy CARLA adapter for source-reviewed four-variant construction.

This is an acquisition attempt, not physical or legal acceptance. Local review
must establish lane markings, relative motion, camera pixels and duration.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
import queue
from pathlib import Path


class NativeAdapter:
    def __init__(self, host: str, port: int, output_dir: Path):
        import carla
        self.carla = carla
        self.client = carla.Client(host, port)
        self.client.set_timeout(30.0)
        self.output_dir = Path(output_dir)
        self.owned = []
        self.sensors = {}
        self.old_settings = None
        self.world = None
        self.frame_rows = []
        self.motion_rows = []
        self.relation_rows = []

    def open_map(self, path: str, expected_sha: str):
        data = Path(path).read_bytes()
        if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != expected_sha:
            raise ValueError("original reviewed OpenDRIVE map hash changed")
        self.world = self.client.generate_opendrive_world(data.decode("utf-8"))
        self.old_settings = self.world.get_settings()
        settings = self.world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 0.05
        self.world.apply_settings(settings)
        self.map = self.world.get_map()

    def spawn_vehicle(self, role: str, lane_id: str, station_m: float,
                      target_speed_mps: float):
        road_id = self.site_road_id
        waypoint = self.map.get_waypoint_xodr(int(road_id), int(lane_id), station_m)
        if waypoint is None:
            raise ValueError("reviewed road/lane/station absent in loaded Native map")
        transform = waypoint.transform
        transform.location.z += 0.4
        blueprints = self.world.get_blueprint_library().filter("vehicle.*")
        if not blueprints:
            raise ValueError("no local vehicle blueprint")
        blueprint = blueprints[0]
        blueprint.set_attribute("role_name", "nrs484b627_1b_" + role)
        actor = self.world.try_spawn_actor(blueprint, transform)
        if actor is None:
            raise ValueError("source-reviewed vehicle spawn point occupied: " + role)
        self.owned.append(actor)
        yaw = math.radians(transform.rotation.yaw)
        velocity = self.carla.Vector3D(math.cos(yaw) * target_speed_mps,
                                       math.sin(yaw) * target_speed_mps, 0.0)
        actor.set_target_velocity(velocity)
        return actor

    def attach_camera(self, name: str, ego, profile: dict):
        blueprint = self.world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
        blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(profile["width"]))
        blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(profile["height"]))
        pose = profile["pose"]
        transform = self.carla.Transform(
            self.carla.Location(x=pose["x"], y=pose["y"], z=pose["z"]),
            self.carla.Rotation(pitch=pose["pitch"], yaw=pose["yaw"], roll=pose["roll"]))
        sensor = self.world.spawn_actor(blueprint, transform, attach_to=ego)
        self.owned.append(sensor)
        received = queue.Queue(maxsize=4)
        sensor.listen(received.put)
        self.sensors[name] = received
        return sensor

    def tick_and_capture(self, frame: int, hz: int, actors: dict, cameras: dict):
        if hz != 20:
            raise ValueError("selected capture requires 20 Hz")
        native_frame = self.world.tick()
        images = {}
        for name, sensor in cameras.items():
            image = self.sensors[name].get(timeout=20.0)
            if image.frame != native_frame:
                raise ValueError("four-camera original frame synchronization failed")
            path = self.output_dir / "capture" / name / f"{frame:06d}.png"
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            image.save_to_disk(str(path))
            images[name] = str(path)
        row = {"frame": frame, "native_frame": native_frame, "time_s": frame / 20,
               "actor_ids": {name: actor.id for name, actor in actors.items()},
               "camera_frames": {name: native_frame for name in images}}
        states = {}
        for name, actor in actors.items():
            waypoint = self.map.get_waypoint(actor.get_location(), project_to_road=False)
            if waypoint is None:
                raise ValueError("original actor has left reviewed road")
            velocity = actor.get_velocity()
            states[name] = {"actor_id": actor.id, "road_id": waypoint.road_id,
                            "lane_id": str(waypoint.lane_id), "station_m": waypoint.s,
                            "speed_mps": math.sqrt(velocity.x ** 2 + velocity.y ** 2 + velocity.z ** 2)}
        ego, follower = states["ego"], states["following_vehicle"]
        same_lane_behind = (ego["road_id"] == follower["road_id"] and
                            ego["lane_id"] == follower["lane_id"] and
                            follower["station_m"] < ego["station_m"])
        intermediates = [state for name, state in states.items()
                         if name not in ("ego", "following_vehicle") and
                         state["road_id"] == ego["road_id"] and
                         state["lane_id"] == ego["lane_id"] and
                         follower["station_m"] < state["station_m"] < ego["station_m"]]
        immediately_behind = same_lane_behind and not intermediates
        slower = states.get("slower_vehicle")
        passing = (slower is not None and ego["road_id"] == slower["road_id"] and
                   ego["station_m"] > slower["station_m"])
        self.motion_rows.append({"frame": frame, "time_s": frame / 20,
            "ego_speed_mps": ego["speed_mps"],
            "follower_gap_m": max(0.0, ego["station_m"] - follower["station_m"]),
            "follower_speed_mps": follower["speed_mps"],
            "ego_lane_id": ego["lane_id"],
            "rightmost_same_direction_lane_id": self.rightmost_lane_id,
            "follower_actor_id": follower["actor_id"],
            "follower_lane_id": follower["lane_id"],
            "passing_slower_vehicle_observed": passing,
            "same_direction_marked_lane_count": self.marked_lane_count})
        self.relation_rows.append({"frame": frame, "time_s": frame / 20,
            "follower_actor_id": follower["actor_id"],
            "immediately_behind": immediately_behind})
        self.frame_rows.append(row)
        with (self.output_dir / "native-frames.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n")

    def close(self):
        if self.frame_rows:
            self.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            def save(name, data):
                (self.output_dir / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            save("original-frame-map.json", {"source_kind": "original_native_frame_map",
                "case_id": self.case_id, "frames": self.frame_rows})
            save("original-motion.json", {"assignment_id": self.assignment_id,
                "case_id": self.case_id, "original_trace_id": self.trace_id,
                "frames": self.motion_rows})
            save("original-relation.json", {"case_id": self.case_id,
                "source_kind": "original_native_relation",
                "relation_basis_source": "original Native road/lane/station actor readback",
                "samples": self.relation_rows})
        for actor in reversed(self.owned):
            try:
                actor.stop() if hasattr(actor, "stop") else None
            except Exception:
                pass
            actor.destroy()
        if self.world is not None and self.old_settings is not None:
            self.world.apply_settings(self.old_settings)

"""Join independently sealed immediate-follower readback to original motion.

The relation source must itself be a reviewed Native observation. This join
does not decide whether the driver's slow speed legally impeded traffic.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from right_lane_measurement import ASSIGNMENT, measure_packet


def _read(path, expected_sha):
    path = Path(path)
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected_sha:
        raise ValueError("original follower source hash mismatch")
    return json.loads(raw)


def finalize(trace_path, trace_sha, relation_path, relation_sha, case_id):
    if not case_id.startswith(ASSIGNMENT + "__"):
        raise ValueError("exact right-lane case required")
    trace = _read(trace_path, trace_sha)
    relation = _read(relation_path, relation_sha)
    if (trace.get("assignment_id") != ASSIGNMENT or trace.get("case_id") != case_id or
            relation.get("case_id") != case_id or
            relation.get("source_kind") != "original_native_relation" or
            not relation.get("relation_basis_source")):
        raise ValueError("original exact follower relation source required")
    frames, readings = trace.get("frames"), relation.get("samples")
    if not isinstance(frames, list) or not isinstance(readings, list) or len(frames) != len(readings) or len(frames) != 900:
        raise ValueError("original 900-frame follower join required")
    first = frames[0].get("frame")
    if type(first) is not int or [row.get("frame") for row in frames] != list(range(first, first + 900)):
        raise ValueError("original frame sequence differs")
    joined = []
    for frame, reading in zip(frames, readings):
        if (reading.get("frame") != frame["frame"] or
                reading.get("time_s") != frame.get("time_s") or
                reading.get("follower_actor_id") != frame.get("follower_actor_id") or
                type(reading.get("immediately_behind")) is not bool):
            raise ValueError("original follower identity/frame/time join differs")
        if "follower_immediately_behind_readback" in frame:
            raise ValueError("unsealed inline follower relation forbidden")
        joined.append({**frame,
                       "follower_immediately_behind_readback": reading["immediately_behind"]})
    packet = {**trace, "frames": joined,
              "follower_relation_source_sha256": relation_sha}
    result = measure_packet(packet, {"trace_sha256": trace_sha,
                                     "relation_sha256": relation_sha})
    result["format"] = "c147344-original-follower-relation-join-v1"
    result["case_id"] = case_id
    result["original_frame_count"] = 900
    result["relation_basis_source"] = relation["relation_basis_source"]
    result["legal_impediment_and_pass_necessity"] = "unresolved"
    return result

"""Independent original-attempt audit for the conditional right-lane cases.

Software checks bind original bytes and complete synchronized video. They do
not decide legal impediment or necessity, or establish physical visibility.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from finalize_follower import finalize
from reviewed_scene import ASSIGNMENT, VARIANTS, _linked, plan

CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def _sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _ref(root: Path, ref: dict) -> Path:
    return _linked(root, ref)


def _probe(path: Path) -> dict:
    command = ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-count_frames",
               "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_frames,r_frame_rate,width,height",
               "-of", "json", str(path)]
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=120)
    streams = json.loads(result.stdout).get("streams", [])
    if len(streams) != 1:
        raise ValueError("one original video stream required")
    return streams[0]


def audit(root: Path, receipt: dict, probe=_probe) -> dict:
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    case_id = receipt.get("case_id", "")
    if case_id not in {ASSIGNMENT + "__" + suffix for suffix in VARIANTS}:
        raise ValueError("exact assigned case required")
    if (receipt.get("source_kind") != "original_native_attempt" or
            receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture") is True or
            receipt.get("native_process_exit_code") != 0 or
            receipt.get("owner_released") is not True or
            not receipt.get("attempt_id") or not receipt.get("recording_id")):
        raise ValueError("successful released original Native attempt required")
    site_ref = receipt.get("site_ref")
    scene = plan(root, site_ref, case_id)
    seal_ref = receipt.get("capture_seal_ref")
    seal_path = _ref(root, seal_ref)
    seal = json.loads(seal_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if (seal.get("source_kind") != "original_native_capture_seal" or
            seal.get("case_id") != case_id or
            seal.get("attempt_id") != receipt["attempt_id"] or
            seal.get("recording_id") != receipt["recording_id"]):
        raise ValueError("sealed original Native attempt identity differs")
    refs = [site_ref, receipt.get("frame_map_ref"), receipt.get("trace_ref"),
            receipt.get("relation_ref")] + list(receipt.get("video_refs", {}).values())
    for ref in refs:
        if not isinstance(ref, dict) or seal.get("sources", {}).get(ref.get("path")) != ref.get("sha256"):
            raise ValueError("sealed original source inventory differs")
    frame_path = _ref(root, receipt.get("frame_map_ref"))
    frame_map = json.loads(frame_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    rows = frame_map.get("frames")
    if (frame_map.get("source_kind") != "original_native_frame_map" or
            frame_map.get("case_id") != case_id or not isinstance(rows, list) or
            len(rows) != 900 or [r.get("frame") for r in rows] != list(range(900))):
        raise ValueError("complete original 900-frame map required")
    native = [r.get("native_frame") for r in rows]
    if any(type(v) is not int for v in native) or any(b <= a for a, b in zip(native, native[1:])):
        raise ValueError("original Native frame IDs not increasing")
    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
        if row.get("time_s") != i / 20 or set(row.get("camera_frames", {})) != set(CAMERAS):
            raise ValueError("original 20 Hz four-camera frame join missing")
        if any(row["camera_frames"][name] != native[i] for name in CAMERAS):
            raise ValueError("four-camera original Native frame mismatch")
    videos = receipt.get("video_refs")
    if not isinstance(videos, dict) or set(videos) != set(CAMERAS):
        raise ValueError("four original camera videos required")
    video_hashes = {}
    for name in CAMERAS:
        path = _ref(root, videos[name])
        stream = probe(path)
        if stream.get("nb_read_frames") != "900" or stream.get("r_frame_rate") != "20/1":
            raise ValueError("original camera full decode or 20 Hz failed: " + name)
        if int(stream.get("width", 0)) < 640 or int(stream.get("height", 0)) < 360:
            raise ValueError("original camera resolution below review floor")
        video_hashes[name] = _sha(path)
    trace_path = _ref(root, receipt.get("trace_ref"))
    relation_path = _ref(root, receipt.get("relation_ref"))
    if json.loads(trace_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("diagnostic_fixture") is True:
        raise ValueError("diagnostic motion source cannot be original delivery")
    observation = finalize(trace_path, receipt["trace_ref"]["sha256"],
                           relation_path, receipt["relation_ref"]["sha256"], case_id)
    measured = observation["observations"]
    if len(measured) != 900:
        raise ValueError("original 900-frame measurement required")
    requested_right = scene["actors"][0]["lane_id"] == scene["rightmost_lane_id"]
    requested_follower = scene["requested_immediate_follower"]
    if (any(row["ego_in_extreme_right_lane"] != requested_right for row in measured) or
            any(row["follower_immediately_behind_in_ego_lane"] != requested_follower for row in measured)):
        raise ValueError("realized lane or follower differs from requested construction")
    if scene["requested_immediate_follower"] and not any(
            row["follower_closing_speed_mps"] > 0 for row in measured):
        raise ValueError("original following traffic did not close on ego")
    if scene.get("requested_passing_slower_vehicle") and not any(
            row["passing_slower_vehicle_observed"] for row in measured):
        raise ValueError("original requested pass not observed")
    return {"format": "c147344-original-attempt-audit-v1", "case_id": case_id,
            "attempt_id": receipt["attempt_id"], "recording_id": receipt["recording_id"],
            "source_kind": "original_native_attempt", "site_sha256": site_ref["sha256"],
            "capture_seal_sha256": _sha(seal_path),
            "map_sha256": scene["map_sha256"], "frame_map_sha256": _sha(frame_path),
            "trace_sha256": _sha(trace_path), "relation_sha256": _sha(relation_path),
            "video_sha256": video_hashes, "frames_checked": 900,
            "checks": ["native_source", "all_participants", "time_join", "full_video_decode",
                       "original_lane_and_follower_readback"],
            "physical_completion": "requires independent local visual and motion review",
            "legal_impediment_and_pass_necessity": "unresolved"}


def main() -> None:
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--authority-root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--receipt", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists() or args.output.resolve().is_relative_to(args.authority_root.resolve()):
        raise ValueError("fresh audit output outside original source root required")
    receipt = json.loads(args.receipt.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    result = audit(args.authority_root, receipt)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Independent source-bound comparison of the four right-lane plans.

Only isolation and observed differences are reported. Impediment and passing
necessity remain human review questions on original Native evidence.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

from reviewed_scene import ASSIGNMENT


PAIRS = {
    "extreme_right_position": ("slow_middle_follower", "slow_right_follower"),
    "passing_exception": ("slow_middle_follower", "slow_middle_passing"),
    "immediate_follower_condition": ("slow_middle_follower", "slow_middle_no_immediate_follower"),
}


def _actors(plan):
    return {row["role"]: row for row in plan["actors"]}


def audit(comparison_id: str, left: dict, right: dict,
          left_result: dict, right_result: dict) -> dict:
    if comparison_id not in PAIRS:
        raise ValueError("unassigned controlled comparison")
    names = PAIRS[comparison_id]
    for plan, result, suffix in ((left, left_result, names[0]),
                                 (right, right_result, names[1])):
        case_id = ASSIGNMENT + "__" + suffix
        if (plan.get("case_id") != case_id or result.get("case_id") != case_id or
                plan.get("format") != "c147344-reviewed-scene-plan-v1" or
                result.get("format") != "c147344-original-follower-relation-join-v1" or
                result.get("original_frame_count") != 900 or
                len(result.get("observations", [])) != 900 or
                not result.get("source", {}).get("trace_sha256") or
                not result.get("source", {}).get("relation_sha256")):
            raise ValueError("exact original comparison case or proof missing")
    if left_result["original_trace_id"] == right_result["original_trace_id"]:
        raise ValueError("comparison reuses one original attempt")
    if left_result["source"]["trace_sha256"] == right_result["source"]["trace_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("comparison reuses one original motion packet")
    for key in ("site_sha256", "map_sha256", "cameras", "hz", "frames", "rightmost_lane_id"):
        if left.get(key) != right.get(key):
            raise ValueError("fixed source or capture condition differs: " + key)
    la, ra = _actors(left), _actors(right)
    if set(la) - {"slower_vehicle"} != set(ra) - {"slower_vehicle"}:
        raise ValueError("fixed vehicle roles differ")
    for role in ("ego", "following_vehicle"):
        for field in ("station_m", "target_speed_mps"):
            if la[role][field] != ra[role][field]:
                raise ValueError("fixed actor control differs")
    if comparison_id == "extreme_right_position":
        isolated = (la["ego"]["lane_id"] != ra["ego"]["lane_id"] and
                    la["following_vehicle"]["lane_id"] == la["ego"]["lane_id"] and
                    ra["following_vehicle"]["lane_id"] == ra["ego"]["lane_id"] and
                    "slower_vehicle" not in la and "slower_vehicle" not in ra)
        field = "ego_in_extreme_right_lane"
    elif comparison_id == "passing_exception":
        isolated = (la["ego"]["lane_id"] == ra["ego"]["lane_id"] and
                    la["following_vehicle"]["lane_id"] == ra["following_vehicle"]["lane_id"] and
                    "slower_vehicle" not in la and "slower_vehicle" in ra)
        field = "passing_slower_vehicle_observed"
    else:
        isolated = (la["ego"]["lane_id"] == ra["ego"]["lane_id"] and
                    la["following_vehicle"]["lane_id"] != ra["following_vehicle"]["lane_id"] and
                    "slower_vehicle" not in la and "slower_vehicle" not in ra)
        field = "follower_immediately_behind_in_ego_lane"
    if not isolated:
        raise ValueError("declared comparison variable not isolated")
    left_values = [row.get(field) for row in left_result["observations"]]
    right_values = [row.get(field) for row in right_result["observations"]]
    if any(type(value) is not bool for value in left_values + right_values):
        raise ValueError("original compared observation missing")
    return {"format": "c147344-source-comparison-v1", "comparison_id": comparison_id,
            "case_ids": [left["case_id"], right["case_id"]],
            "fixed_source_sha256": left["site_sha256"],
            "original_trace_ids": [left_result["original_trace_id"], right_result["original_trace_id"]],
            "compared_field": field,
            "observed_true_frames": [sum(left_values), sum(right_values)],
            "comparison_isolated": True, "physical_acceptance": False,
            "legal_impediment_or_exception": "unresolved"}


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--comparison", choices=tuple(PAIRS), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--left-plan", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--right-plan", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--left-result", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--right-result", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists():
        raise ValueError("fresh comparison audit output required")
    data = [json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for path in
            (args.left_plan, args.right_plan, args.left_result, args.right_result)]
    result = audit(args.comparison, *data)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Saved-only exact-case original motion/relation finalization.

This never starts CARLA, edits acquisition, or infers legal impediment.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from finalize_follower import finalize
from reviewed_scene import ASSIGNMENT, VARIANTS


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def process(attempt: Path, output: Path, case_id: str, diagnostic_fixture=False) -> dict:
    attempt, output = Path(attempt).resolve(), Path(output).resolve()
    if case_id not in {ASSIGNMENT + "__" + suffix for suffix in VARIANTS}:
        raise ValueError("exact selected case required")
    if output.exists() or output.is_relative_to(attempt) or attempt.is_relative_to(output):
        raise ValueError("fresh derived output outside original acquisition required")
    trace, relation = attempt / "trace.json", attempt / "relation.json"
    for path in (trace, relation):
        if not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + path.name)
    trace_sha, relation_sha = sha(trace), sha(relation)
    trace_data = json.loads(trace.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if bool(trace_data.get("diagnostic_fixture")) != bool(diagnostic_fixture):
        raise ValueError("original versus diagnostic source provenance mismatch")
    measurement = finalize(trace, trace_sha, relation, relation_sha, case_id)
    if sha(trace) != trace_sha or sha(relation) != relation_sha:
        raise ValueError("saved processing changed original acquisition")
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    (output / "measurement.json").write_text(json.dumps(measurement, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    receipt = {"format": "c147344-recorded-only-processing-v1", "case_id": case_id,
               "source_kind": "synthetic_software_fixture" if diagnostic_fixture else "original_native_attempt",
               "trace_sha256": trace_sha, "relation_sha256": relation_sha,
               "measurement_sha256": sha(output / "measurement.json"),
               "original_frame_count": measurement["original_frame_count"],
               "analysis_complete": True, "legal_verdict_claimed": False,
               "delivery_ready": False}
    (output / "processing-receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return receipt


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--case", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--diagnostic-fixture", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(process(args.attempt, args.output, args.case, args.diagnostic_fixture), sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
